name: Alessandro Romano
review: Lead & Fang didn’t just redesign our brand — they changed how people perceived the business. Within months, we were seeing stronger engagement across our campaigns and noticeably better-quality inquiries.

name: Sofia Bellini
review: What makes Lead & Fang different is that they actually think like part of your business. Every creative decision had a reason behind it, and the final work gave our marketing team a much stronger foundation to build from.

name: Khalid Al Mansoori
review: They took a brand that looked like everyone else in our industry and gave it a presence of its own. Sophisticated, confident, and immediately recognizable.

name: Elena Morozova
review: We came to Lead & Fang because our marketing looked beautiful but wasn’t really working. They completely rethought the visual direction, simplified the messaging, and created a much stronger connection between the brand and the customer. The difference in engagement after the launch was immediate.

name: James Whitmore
review: Some designers make things look good. Lead & Fang understands how to make design actually work for a business.

name: Anastasia Kovalenko
review: They became a genuine extension of our team. There was never a feeling of ‘client versus agency’ — we were solving the problem together. That collaboration resulted in some of the strongest creative work our brand has ever produced.

name: Matteo Ricci
review: Our new identity changed the conversation around the business. Customers started noticing the brand, not just the product.

name: Aisha Al Nuaimi
review: Lead & Fang understood that we weren’t looking for another pretty luxury brand. We needed something distinctive enough to compete in a very crowded market. They created an identity that gave us exactly that — and translated it beautifully across packaging, digital, advertising, and print.

name: Oleksandr Shevchenko
review: For years, the quality of our work was significantly better than the quality of our marketing. Lead & Fang finally closed that gap. Our presentations, proposals, advertising, and brand materials now reflect the company we’ve actually become.

name: Victoria Sokolova
review: The redesign made an immediate difference. Our campaigns became clearer, engagement improved, and for the first time our entire organization looked and sounded like one brand.

name: Luca Moretti
review: We expected new packaging. What we got was a completely new level of recognition for the brand. Customers started identifying our products before they even saw the name.

name: Daniel Harrington
company_position: VP of Sales & Marketing, Automotive Services
review: Our biggest challenge was turning a very technical service into something customers could understand quickly. Lead & Fang completely changed the way we communicated it. The new sales materials are simpler, more persuasive, and our team actually enjoys using them.

name: Daria Melnyk
review: The rebrand changed more than our visuals. People stayed longer, interacted more, and we started seeing a clear improvement in the quality of traffic converting into customers.

name: Fahad Al Marri
company_position: Chief Commercial Officer, Property Investment Group
review: Lead & Fang brought clarity to a brand that had become fragmented as the company grew. They created one visual system across our presentations, advertising, digital content, and corporate materials. The difference in how we present ourselves to investors and partners is enormous.

name: Ekaterina Volkova
review: They are incredibly creative, but creativity was never the goal just for the sake of it.
